title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium): customer-managed keys for review set data at rest
summary: Hold: the checklist directs administrators to an enablement command to check existing onboarding, and the low cost rating overlooks documented Azure key-management charges. The required roles also need to be qualified for Azure Key Vault rather than Managed HSM, and Microsoft's conflicting statements about review set encryption should both be reported.

claims.quote: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data stored in eDiscovery review sets

claims.claim: Customer Key adds an encryption layer using customer-controlled keys.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 also offers an added layer of encryption for your content through Customer Key.

claims.claim: Customer Key encrypts only data at rest in the cloud.

claims.quote: Customer Key lets you control your organization's encryption keys and configure Microsoft 365 to use those keys; The setup process differs depending on whether you're using Azure Key Vault or Managed HSM.
